candidates.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion should XOR each bit with the previous bit, but the LSB is incorrectly XORed with bit 2 instead of bit 1, causing incorrect binary values
candidates.spec_basis: The Gray code to binary conversion should follow the pattern where each bit is XORed with the more significant bit (bin_out[i] = gray_wire[i] ^ bin_out[i+1])
